svg.title: block1.q · all-reduce
svg.desc: Global element 64 has 4 holders. Pending reduction axes: none. Colored numbered global cells map to logical mesh participants and a local tensor.
svg.text: HSDP 4 × 4 · release weights · batch 16 · logical participants
Numbers label global elements, not numerical values. Stronger
fill marks the selected participant's ownership.
4 declared replicas of a complete value. No pending
reduction; this diagram shows declared ownership.
Rows: replicate axis · columns: shard axis
Filled dot: holds selected element · dashed frame: collective group
Miniatures show the same global window as the numbered grid.
all-reduce on replicate: holders of selected element in highlighted group: 4 before → 4 after.
Derived from checked HIR. Diagrams show logical ownership and declared value state; they do not model a physical network schedule.
